notes.title: Many Thanks & Fixes
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I deeply appreciate all the feedback we've been getting, even the negative ones.
Its true that sometimes they hurt but hey, there's always good juice in their reviews that helps me become a better developer.

I've been out of the country for a while and will be back in 2 weeks, i find it lovely how even after second chances there are still users who're waiting for the fixes. You guys are always on my mind and i'll get to the fixing as soon as i can.

Regarding subtitles, im sorry but the game isn't optimised for it, i never expected a little 8 min demo game to turn into something so big, its surprisingly very difficult but will be available for the coming projects.

Thank you for understanding!
